On March 4, a week into the illegal war with Iran, Lindsey Graham says that within 3-4 weeks, the Iranian government would lose control over some cities.

And by the end of that week, the Arab states would be more "openly" involved in the war, he predicts, suggesting that some Arab states were secretly involved in the war from the outset.

We are now on day 150 and not a single Iranian city has fallen.

America is so much worse off listening to this warmonger's deranged fantasies.
